up: Return a list of approved drugs indicated for pancreatic carcinoma. For each drug, provide the preferred name, the ChEMBL ID, and the maximum clinical phase. Only include drugs with max_phase = 4.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, md.max_phase FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.mesh_heading = 'Pancreatic Neoplasms';
